965ee1.title: Recon: www.hritish.space — static portfolio on Vercel
965ee1.content:
## Recon summary — https://www.hritish.space

### Hosting / infra
- Vercel edge (CNAME www -> 6bde006691164b19.vercel-dns-017.com; A 216.198.79.65 / 64.29.17.65, both VERCEL-05/12 netblocks; apex 216.198.79.1)
- DNS: Namecheap/registrar-servers (NS dns1/2.registrar-servers.com, MX eforward1-5.registrar-servers.com)
- TLS: Let's Encrypt "YR2" issuer, CN=www.hritish.space, SAN only www.hritish.space, RSA-2048/SHA256, valid Jun 27 2026 - Sep 25 2026
- Ports (naabu on 216.198.79.65): 21, 80, 443 (21 = shared Vercel edge tenant, FTP banner no response)

### Tech stack
- Static single-page HTML site ("HRITISH — Software, Security, Systems", "Issue 01", personal portfolio of Hritish Narayanan)
- Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS (no framework): main.js (11.4K, empty-client interactions: scroll reveal, ASCII scramble, parallax), style.css (24.8K), Google Fonts (UnifrakturMaguntia, Instrument Serif, Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Mono)
- Server: `Server: Vercel`, `X-Vercel-Cache`, `X-Vercel-Id: bom1::...`, `X-Vercel-Error`, `X-Vercel-Mitigated: challenge`, `X-Vercel-Challenge-Token`
- No CMS, no backend APIs, no forms, no query params, no cookies set on main site

### Vercel Firewall (WAF) behavior — site-wide
- Non-browser clients (curl/ffuf/arjun) get 403 EVERYWHERE incl "/" and static assets: `X-Vercel-Mitigated: challenge`, token, `Cache-Control: private, no-store`; title "Vercel Security Checkpoint"; body is an Astro-rendered page w/ `data-astro-cid` (Vercel uses Astro for checkpoint UI). wafw00f/no WAF detected (it sits on Vercel edge)
- Real browser passes challenge, gets homepage 200. After browser pass, ANY unknown path -> plain-text 404 "NOT_FOUND" (79 bytes) with `X-Vercel-Error: NOT_FOUND`
- `/.env`, `/.git/HEAD`, `/api*`, `/graphql`, `/login`, `/admin`, `/package.json`, `/index.php` all 404 in browser (not real; no hidden paths)
- `/wedding`, `/news`, `/newreply` return 403-challenge for curl => because WAF shields everything, their absence is NOT confirmed; they may be 404s too. Not validated due to challenge.

### Endpoints (browser-verified)
- / 200, /index.html 200 (same homepage), /main.js 200, /style.css 200, /robots.txt 200 ("Allow: /"), /assets/me.png + /assets/me.jpg 200 (seen by browser)
- /sitemap.xml 404. All fuzz hits (.env, .git, admin, api, login, wp-*, package.json...) 404 via browser.

### Headers / security
- Present: `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000` (only via challenge/browser; curl-200 pages have HSTS too in 404 sample), `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` (on static 200), `Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate`, Etag, Content-Disposition: inline
- Missing: CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, no Content-Security-Policy
- No Set-Cookie anywhere (no cookies on the app; challenge uses JS/local, no cookies observed)
- HTTP->HTTPS: 308 permanent; www/apex both serve the same homepage (no bare trailing redirect observed)

### JS analysis
- main.js: NO urls, NO api endpoints, NO keys/secrets/tokens/passwords/aws/firebase/supabase. Only DOM animation code. IP check clean.
- No inline scripts on homepage. No JS bundles (no framework bundles, no source maps observed).

### Fuzzing / params
- ffuf common.txt (4751): only /wedding /news /newreply 403 (WAF challenge, not real files)
- ffuf raft-small-words (43k) timed out w/ zero signal (spray filled by challenge 403s)
- arjun on / — no params discovered on static page (jobs terminated / no output)

### Subdomains (passive)
- subfinder: only www.hritish.space. certspotter: hritish.space + www.hritish.space only. crt.sh API was 502 during scan. No other subdomains known.

### Cookies
- None set on any tested response.

### Proxy corroboration
- Caido sitemap shows only baseline URLs (/, /main.js, /style.css, /robots.txt) + the fuzz spray; server 708 on one nonce response (Vercel internal 708 code) and 204 POST to /.well-known/vercel/security/request-challenge (browser challenge ping) observed in proxy history.
